headline: Approved consent agenda items and recommended City Council approve HR reclassification, parking financing, and wastewater contracts.
summary: The Board of Finance adopted a consent agenda that approved the September 14, 2026 minutes and recommended City Council approve a Burlington Electric Department contract extension with Shelburne Limestone and up to $108,000 for an ecosystem services analysis. The board also voted to recommend City Council approve reclassifying the Human Resources Manager position, authorize parking revenue financing up to $1.6 million, approve a contract with Alfa Laval for belt filter press work, and authorize an $8,509,830 Step II loan with related contracts for Stage 1 Main Wastewater Plant Improvements. All motions passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved the September 14, 2026 Board of Finance Meeting Minutes as part of the consent agenda.
Approved and recommended that City Council authorize a 3-year extension, with an option for a 4th year, of the Burlington Electric Department agreement with Shelburne Limestone Corporation.
Approved and recommended that City Council approve use of up to $108,000 from the Conservation Legacy Fund for an ecosystem services analysis.
Approved and recommended that City Council reclassify the Human Resources Manager position from Grade 20 to Grade 21.
Approved and recommended that City Council adopt a resolution authorizing parking revenue financing for capital improvements not to exceed $1.6 million.
Approved and recommended that City Council authorize a $290,960 contract with Alfa Laval, with $19,340 in contingency funding, for the rebuild of Belt Filter Press #2.

Approved and recommended that City Council adopt a resolution authorizing an $8,509,830 Step II loan and related contracts with Wright-Pierce, PC Construction, and Stantec for Stage 1 Main Wastewater Plant Improvements.
